patterns: Dominant shape: one-liners - who invited Gandhi (Rajkumar Shukla), Tinkathia = indigo on 3/20, first satyagraha = Champaran, first hunger strike = Ahmedabad.
Chronology items (Champaran -> Ahmedabad -> Kheda -> Rowlatt -> NCM) recur heavily.
'Not associated' person traps: Lohia, JP Narayan vs Rajendra Prasad, Kripalani, A.N. Sinha; Agrarian Committee membership.
APPSC itself asked why Kheda was called off (revenue only from those able to pay) and Gandhi journals (Mathrubhumi trap).
App adds Jallianwala Bagh depth and some opinion/significance items not seen in PYQs; TLA founder keyed as Gandhi in exams, app credited Anusuya.
